definition.name: Old maps and charts
definition.description: Decorative maps, city plans, bird's-eye views and celestial charts made before 1900, for a screen that rewards a closer look.

credit.creator: Denframe
credit.attribution: The collection's first works, side by side.

works.alt_text: A pictorial map of the Tōkaidō road crowded with tiny towns, rivers and bays in green and blue, with Mount Fuji and a red sun at the top left.

placard.title: The Famous Places on the Tokaido in One View (Tokaido meisho ichiran)
placard.creator: Katsushika Hokusai 葛飾 北斎 (Japanese, 1760-1849)

works.alt_text: A hand-coloured allegorical map of a Kingdom of Love, with pastel regions, rivers, little mountains and German place names.

placard.title: Valentine: Map of the Kingdom of Love (Das Reich der Liebe)
placard.creator: Breitkopf & Härtel (German)
placard.medium: Printed on paper from type composition, hand-colored

works.alt_text: A hand-coloured bird's-eye map of Alexandria, its walled city on a green coast with sailing ships on a blue sea.

placard.title: Map of Alexandria
placard.creator: Georg Braun (German, 1541–1622)

works.alt_text: A coloured street map of lower Manhattan with ward boundaries, a street index at the side and small pictures of buildings along the top.

placard.title: The City of New York: Longworth's Explanatory Map and Plan
placard.creator: David Longworth (American, died 1821)

works.alt_text: A Japanese world map of two hemispheres on a dark blue ground, with continents in red, yellow and green under a red title panel.

placard.title: The Map of the Globe, Terminal Page of the set of eight Pictures of Foreign Ships
placard.creator: Unknown Artist (Japanese, date unknown)

works.alt_text: An engraved map of Greece and the Aegean Sea crowded with islands and place names, with a decorative cartouche at the lower left.

placard.title: Map of Greece, from "Speculum Romanae Magnificentiae"
placard.creator: Sebastiano di Re (Italian, active Rome, 1557–63)

works.alt_text: An engraved plan of ancient Rome showing its monuments, walls and the winding Tiber, with Latin text panels.

placard.title: Plan of Ancient Rome, from "Speculum Romanae Magnificentiae"
placard.creator: Pirro Ligorio (Italian, Naples ca. 1512/13–1583 Ferrara)

works.alt_text: A pale drawn map of the hills and walls of ancient Rome beside a classical monument where a man sits reading.

placard.title: Map of Ancient Rome Illustrating Major Monuments and the Seven Hills
placard.creator: Jan Goeree (Dutch, Middelburg 1670–1731 Amsterdam)
placard.medium: Brush and gray wash, pen and gray and brown ink over red and black chalk

works.alt_text: An engraved plan of eighteenth-century Rome on joined sheets, with a decorative title cartouche, a compass rose and long index columns.

placard.title: Plan of ancient Rome with a view of the Pantheon lower left and a triumphal arch lower right
placard.creator: Carlo Nolli (Italian, Como 1724–after 1770 Naples)
placard.medium: Etching, sixteen separate sheets joined and backed on linen

works.alt_text: A plan of ancient Rome drawn as fragments of a broken marble map, with the word ROMA in large letters across the top.

placard.title: Plan of Rome..., from "Le Antichità Romane" (Roman Antiquities)
placard.creator: Giovanni Battista Piranesi (Italian, Mogliano Veneto 1720–1778 Rome)

works.alt_text: A bird's-eye engraving of Venice floating in its lagoon, with mountains beyond, coats of arms at the top and Latin verses below.

placard.title: View of Venice
placard.creator: Anonymous, Dutch, 17th century

works.alt_text: A pale map of early New York at the tip of Manhattan, with streets, wharves, a large title and coats of arms.

placard.title: A Plan of the City of New York from an Actual Survey Made by James Lyne, 1728
placard.creator: James Lyne (American or British, active 1728–44)

works.alt_text: A black and white bird's-eye view of New York and Brooklyn on either side of the East River, crowded with ships.

placard.title: Bird's Eye View of New York and Brooklyn
placard.creator: John Bachmann (American, born Switzerland, 1814/15–1896)

works.alt_text: An engraved view of the Inn Valley with steep alpine peaks above fields and villages, and two smaller valley scenes below.

placard.title: The Inn Valley from the series Civitates Orbis Terrarum, vol. V, plate 59
placard.creator: Simon Novellanus (Netherlandish, 16th century)

works.alt_text: A coloured bird's-eye view of the Brooklyn Bridge lit by fireworks over a night harbour full of sailing boats and steamers.

placard.title: Bird's-Eye View of the Great New York and Brooklyn Bridge, and Grand Display of Fireworks on Opening Night...May 24, 1883
placard.creator: A. Major (New York, NY)

works.alt_text: A facsimile of an early world map on a heart-shaped projection, ringed by puffing wind heads, printed on cream paper.

placard.title: Map of the World: Tradewinds
placard.creator: Unknown Artist (English, 19th century) (published by Bernardi Sylvani (Italian, active 1511))
placard.medium: Woodcut in black on cream laid paper

works.alt_text: A facsimile of Mercator's map of the Arctic, a round map of the North Pole in a decorative square frame with corner roundels.

placard.title: Map of the Mercator Projection
placard.creator: Unknown Artist (English, 19th century)
placard.medium: Engraving in black on cream laid paper

works.alt_text: A Japanese print of an ornate celestial globe on a red stand, below a black title panel with large characters and red seals.

placard.title: Celestial Globe, Cover of the set of eight Pictures of Foreign Ships
placard.creator: Unknown Artist (Japanese, date unknown)

works.alt_text: A woodcut bird's-eye view of part of Venice from high above, with the lagoon, distant mountains and wind heads in the clouds.

placard.title: View of Venice
placard.creator: Jacopo de' Barbari (Italian, c. 1460/70–c. 1516)
placard.medium: woodcut from six blocks on six sheets of paper

works.alt_text: A woodcut bird's-eye view of the whole of Venice set in its lagoon, surrounded by ships, clouds and small islands.

placard.title: View of Venice
placard.creator: Jacopo de' Barbari (Italian, c. 1460/70–c. 1516)
placard.medium: woodcut from six blocks on six sheets of paper

works.alt_text: A section of an engraved street plan of Rome showing a bend of the Tiber, city blocks and gardens in fine black lines.

placard.title: Nuova pianta di Roma data in luce da Giambattista Nolli l’anno MDCCXLVII, known as La Pianta Grande di Roma
placard.creator: Giovanni Battista Nolli (Italian, 1701–1756)

works.alt_text: A section of an engraved street plan of central Rome, densely packed with dark city blocks between pale streets and squares.

placard.title: Nuova pianta di Roma data in luce da Giambattista Nolli l’anno MDCCXLVII, known as La Pianta Grande di Roma
placard.creator: Giovanni Battista Nolli (Italian, 1701–1756)

works.alt_text: A coloured view looking down on a busy London livestock market, with pens of sheep and cattle in a square ringed by houses.

placard.title: A Bird's Eye View of Smithfield Market, Taken from the Bear & Ragged Staff
placard.creator: Thomas Rowlandson (British, London 1757–1827 London)
placard.dimensions: Sheet (trimmed within platemark): 14 7/16 in. × 21 in. (36.7 × 53.3 cm)

works.alt_text: An etched view of the walled town of Augsburg across a river, with a tall church tower rising above the roofs.

placard.title: Augsburg, from "German Views"
placard.creator: Wenceslaus Hollar (Bohemian, Prague 1607–1677 London)
